label: Bible Study
prompt: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of _____, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verse: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
note: Paul links Genesis 1 to conversion — the God who said 'Let there be light' does it again in hearts.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the _____ of God.
verse: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
note: Eating, drinking and enjoying your work — the Preacher calls it the gift of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the _____ of the ointment.
verse: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
note: Mary of Bethany's pound of spikenard filled the whole house with its odour — a gift you could smell from every room.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of _____ fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verse: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
note: Jesus explains his coming death in farm terms: a seed that refuses to die stays a lonely single seed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall _____ all my will.
verse: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
note: Paul quoting God on David: 'a man after mine own heart' — and the KJV spells fulfil with just one l.
